title: alert-ingress
description: Turns a cloud notification into an Alertmanager alert. Strict: an unknown key fails the render rather than being silently ignored, because a typo in an alerting path is a rule that never fires.

matchRule.description: JSON-path equalities against the message's own body, plus the SNS envelope under `_sns` (TopicArn, Subject, Message, MessageId, Type). A value of "*" tests presence only.

alertSpec.description: Whether `alertname` and `severity` may be blank is a render-time refusal in templates/_validate.tpl, with a message that says what an accidental default tier costs — not a bare schema requirement.

alertname.description: A Go template over the message body.

severity.description: A Go template over the message body.

networkPolicyPeer.description: One entry of a NetworkPolicy `to`/`from` list — a podSelector, namespaceSelector and/or ipBlock, exactly as the NetworkPolicy API shapes it.

repository.description: Defaults to ghcr.io/truvity/observability/alert-ingress, the image the release workflow builds and pushes. Refused empty so an override typo renders cleanly and pulls nothing, loudly.

tag.description: Empty (the default) resolves to .Chart.AppVersion at render time.

metricsPort.description: 0 (the default) serves /healthz and /metrics on `port`. Non-zero serves them only on this separate port, which the Service does not expose. Must differ from `port`.

selfMonitor.description: Render a PodMonitor. Refused false only loudly: the counters exist and nobody scrapes them is exactly the shape a deadman cannot see its own death in.

topics.description: Refused empty at render time (templates/_validate.tpl): an endpoint that confirms any topic can be subscribed to anyone's topic and fed alerts.

matchRegex.description: RE2 patterns, each searched in the text at a path (use `_sns.Message` or `_sns.Subject` for plain-text publishers). All of `match` and `matchRegex` must hold.

match.description: Refused empty at render time (templates/_validate.tpl): without it the path this service sits on could die unnoticed.

alertmanagerPeer.description: Refused empty while `enabled` (templates/_validate.tpl): otherwise this NetworkPolicy would allow egress to nothing at all, indistinguishable at a glance from one that was actually wired up.

dns.description: Optional. Narrows the DNS egress rule (UDP+TCP 53) to these NetworkPolicy peers. Empty (the default): port 53 to any destination.
